title: Simple Hands-On Simulation Example: Gazebo + ROS 2
description: This example demonstrates how to create a simple simulation environment with a robot in Gazebo and control it using ROS 2. We'll use the TurtleBot3 as an example robot, which is a common choice for educational and research purposes.
